Thanks — I pulled the SAML trace that Helio will send (they attached a RelayState dump in a quick follow-up — I've attached a small relaystate-dump.txt to this thread). Initial findings:

- The SAML assertion itself looks valid (signature and cert OK). Audience is the Workday tenant id as expected.
- The RelayState token delivered from our invite includes an unescaped ampersand and a query parameter string; under normal browsers that's fine, but Helio's proxy appears to rewrite or double-encode query delimiters (eg. '&' -> '&' or '%' encoding), which would truncate the effective token Workday receives.
- When RelayState is truncated, Workday renders a generic 'Account not configured for external users' message because it can't locate the pending invite context.

Suggested immediate actions:
1) Marissa generate a one-time acceptance token (raw token) and a short manual URL that accepts a pasted token in the path or body rather than relying on query params. This will prevent proxy from mangling the token.
2) Ask Helio to try incognito or disable proxy for a brief test.
3) I'll open INF-1423 with the SAML traces attached and mark as high priority for a longer-term change to token placement (avoid query params).

Attaching: relaystate-dump.txt (text stub).

-Ben
